public_body: Minuteman Advisory Group On Interlocal Coordination (Magic)
overall: Group violated the law by failing to record posting date/time for the Dec 3, 2024 notice and by failing to post notice for the Dec 19, 2024 meeting; other allegations were not violations.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the group failed to post notice of an 'early November 2024' meeting, based on a staff email referring to a subregion meeting announcement.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we are constrained to find that the Group did not violate the Open Meeting Law in this regard.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged no notice for the December 3, 2024 meeting was posted when checked on December 14, 2024, after the meeting date.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find no evidence that the Group failed to timely post notice

allegations.summary: The notice for the December 3, 2024 meeting did not record the date and time it was posted, as required by the posting regulation.
allegations.key_passage: We do, however, find that the Group violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to record the date and time that the notice was posted.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the group failed to post notice of its December 19, 2024 meeting; the group acknowledged posting only the date, with no time, place, or topics.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Group violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to post notice of the meeting held on December 19, 2024.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
Within 60 days, create minutes of the December 19, 2024 meeting to the best of its ability and certify to the AG's office that it has done so.
Within 60 days, create and approve minutes of the December 3, 2024 meeting to the extent it has not already done so.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
